title: Mochiii MCP catalog, version 1
description: The servers the Mochiii MCP marketplace offers. catalog.json holds the verified tier and points at community.json for the rest. Every entry names a program a user's Mochiii daemon will run with their full privileges once they type its name to confirm; clients re-check every rule below and drop an entry that breaks one.

community.description: catalog.json only: where the community tier is, relative to this file, and how many entries it holds.

plain.description: Text with no control characters and no bidirectional overrides.

id.description: The server name Mochiii stores it under and approval prompts show. Same rule as the daemon's.

namespace.description: The server's name in the official MCP Registry, whose owner the registry verified.

tier.description: verified: chosen and reviewed by Mochiii. community: imported from the MCP Registry, not reviewed.

icon.description: Names a logo bundled with the Mochiii extension, such as github. Never a URL or a path: the extension looks it up among its own files and fetches nothing.

version.description: An exact version. Never a range or a tag like latest.

launch.description: Exactly what runs. command is npx for npm, uvx for pypi, docker for oci, and args must begin with the package pinned to its version: npx -y <identifier>@<version> / uvx <identifier>@<version> / docker run -i --rm [-e NAME]... <image:tag>.

env.description: Variables the server reads, by NAME. A value is never carried: the user sets it in their own environment.

name.description: Never OPENROUTER_API_KEY, MOCHIII_API_KEY or MOCHIII_PROXY_KEY, in any case: Mochiii's own credentials are not passed to a server.

cwd.description: Absent: a private folder of its own. workspace: inside the project.
